osmTags.inscription: Gottes Wort mit uns in Ewigkeit
Wer vielen nutzen kann, tut besser, als wer nur für wenige was schreibet. Georg- Philipp TELEMAMM geb. am 14.3.1681 in Magdeburg gest. am 25.6.1767 in Hamburg 1967
WIR SIND NICHT ZU BEZWINGEN HIER BEFAND SICH DAS BRAUNE HAUS-FOLTERHÖLLE FÜR ANTIFASCHISTEN 1934-1945

Hier wurde am 22.2.1924 das Reichsbanner Schwarz-Rot-Gold gegründet. Bis zu seinem Verbot 1933 trat dieser Verband mutig und geschlossen anti-republikanischen und anti-demokratischen Tendenzen entgegen.
Anläßlich der 75. Wiederkehr des Gründungstages gest

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Location and terrain only. OpenStreetMap has no mapped outline for this site.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:relation/194991 historic=castle Q1408941 1134 m from ledger point
site is a site relation of 51 parts and none of them outlines the whole site, so no outline is drawn; the scene is fitted to the parts (4978 x 8093 m)
present-day buildings capped: kept the 60 nearest the outline centre of 128 mapped (trace size budget); the rest of the town is not drawn
roads capped: kept the 80 longest of 927 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
